notes.title: New Game Announcement: Claymores of the Lost Kingdom
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
I'm happy to announce Claymores of the Lost Kingdom! It is a single player Card Game with deep character building mechanics, map exploration, and some strong RPG flavor.

Wishlist here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473260/Claymores_of_the_Lost_Kingdom/
